title: Conflict-Aware Hallucination Detection in Multi-Document Summarization
summary: Detecting hallucinated claims in summaries built from several sources, where the sources themselves disagree — separating genuine source conflict from fabrication.

title: Green Federated Learning for Intrusion Detection in IoT
summary: An energy-aware federated learning setup for intrusion detection on IoT devices, trading off detection accuracy against communication and compute cost on constrained hardware.
